claims: For every finite M>0, there is a new epsilon_PF(M)>0 such that a local suitable weak solution defined near the closed unit cylinder with A(1)+E(1)<=M and integral_Q1 |grad Theta(grad u)|^2<epsilon_PF(M) is regular at the centre. Each solution retains its own locally L^(3/2) pressure; no common original-pressure D(1) bound is assumed.

Kwon's localized Leray decomposition supplies time-compact corrected velocities and bounded spatially smooth harmonic parts, with all corrected pressure and force terms retained. Time-slice rank-one/affine classification yields the selection-independent bound |tr((grad v)^2)|<=C(M)(1+|grad v|). This gives an L2 corrected-pressure source, the stated L2-force integrability bootstrap and velocity-only transfer to the original suitable solutions.

The accompanying VR.1-9 internal check retains original norm dissipation, zero-set defect, both slices and every variable-reference derivative. Perfect matching cancels the original directional dissipation through the new derivative term; the relative-direction rewrite introduces an uncontrolled radial pairing. This closes only the checked formal absorption subbranch and is not a separately counted completed research section.
